figure: Figure 23 -- EmbedKDECheck TP/FN by corruption type, raw vs. medspaCy-condensed transcript
source: Raw: Logs/evaluate_EmbedKdeChecker_full57_20260819_232035.json (published). Condensed: Logs/evaluate_EmbedKdeChecker_full57_condensed_20260911_212504.json (batch_runs/kde_batch57_condensed.py -- same checker, same 57 files, same labels, transcript pre-filtered through Medical condensor/medspacy_condenser_new.py's MedspacyCondenserNew before EmbedKdeChecker.check(), testing the first fix proposed in Sec 9.3.6).
description: TP/FN per injected corruption type, using the same 6 detail_type categories and display labels as Figure 4 (left), compared across two conditions: the published run on the raw transcript, and a new run with the transcript pre-filtered by the medspaCy condenser before it reaches the KDE. detail_type is label metadata carried only by a matched ground-truth item (Modules/evaluate.py), so a false positive -- a flag with no matching label -- cannot be attributed to a corruption type; total_fp is reported separately per condition, not split across the rows below. Per-type ground-truth totals (tp+fn) are identical across both conditions since the labels themselves don't change, only which ones are caught.
